sourceMethods: All 128 subnet profiles and 93 September 12–13 channel briefs checked, with previous reports used to distinguish new developments from recaps.

161 public X account candidates checked (153 available), producing 142 unique recent post records. Signed-in X broad and targeted Latest searches, selected full posts and a signed-in Grok scan supplied additional leads. Grok’s claims were checked against primary sources before use.

Signed-in AlphaGap Feed: 34 distinct subnet cards reviewed, including recent development, pricing and emissions leads. SubnetRadar, TAO Daily, TAO Media and the public subnet news feed were also reviewed.

159 repository paths scanned with commit pagination from the prior cutoff and refreshed through 11:21 AM ET. Twenty-one selected patches were inspected in detail; Thirty Spokes’ newly discovered current repository was read separately.

SubnetRadar Moments: 31 linked in-window event cards reviewed, including paired SN112 conviction records. Engy and ReadyAI burn transactions, Epago’s live dashboard and Almanac’s revenue methodology were checked directly.
Market and emissions snapshot at 11:20 AM ET compared with yesterday’s saved data. Price figures use rolling 24-hour alpha/TAO changes; slot re-registration gains were excluded from ordinary movers.
YouTube Videos and Live tabs checked. September 12 members upload verified on its watch page and added; no newer public upload or upcoming livestream found in the sampled tabs.
accessGaps: All 128 current subnet profiles were reviewed, but X searches, public account timelines and AlphaGap cards were sampled. Private, deleted, unindexed and unsampled posts may be missing. This is broad coverage, not a claim to have captured every announcement.

Private Discord messages were not directly accessed. Digest-only operational reports remain developing, including ORO scheduling, Ridges reopening, NOVA’s winner, Vidaio’s reported exploit fixes, Score’s rule changes, BitMind recovery and Refinery weights.

Almanac’s page was compiled September 10 and uses buyback USD as a proxy for revenue pending a separate fee feed. Its burn methodology tracks alpha leaving the accumulation wallet without an undelegate; September alpha is perpetually locked. The full financial history was not independently reconstructed.

Engy and ReadyAI successful add_stake_burn transactions were checked in the explorer. Customer-revenue attribution and monthly growth claims remain project-reported. ReadyAI’s transaction predates this window; today’s disclosure supplies the update.

UMI’s chain details are drawn from dated project deployment records. Epago’s live register confirms a running round in burn phase. Neither establishes completed independent model evaluation or all-miner payouts. The screener comparison is not an administrative transaction audit.

Thirty Spokes’ member digest says live, but its current README says testnet rehearsal before SN99 opening; older website documentation describes a retired mechanism. A new mainnet launch was not confirmed. A Grok lead about a named SN76 successor also lacked sufficient primary evidence.

SN112’s lock reduction and addition occur together and are not proof of a market sale or a future release schedule. Coldkey swaps do not by themselves establish a sale to another person. No verified forward unlock calendar was found.

The Chutes training run, Bitcast interview, Swarm commercial deal, Leadpoet Arena launch and RedTeam bank pipeline predate this edition’s fresh window. Recaps retain their dates; no new signed banking contract or additional TAO/Bankr launch was established.

5 repository paths were inaccessible; per-path errors are retained in the audit. Ridges returned a security checkpoint. Source checks occurred at different times; the last repository and market refresh ended at 11:21 AM ET.

editorialDecisions.decision: New official revenue page. 92,130.31 USD is cumulative, compiled Sep10. Revenue equals buyback proxy, not independent fee feed. 56,468.9 alpha burned; 12,562.9 Sep alpha locked. Do not report a new $100K burn today.
Explorer confirms Sep13 09:49UTC add_stake_burn, netuid53 amount45150000000rao =45.15TAO. Dashboard1758.69alpha/$10546.58. Customer-revenue provenance remains attributed.
Explorer9048873-0004 succeeded Sep12 03:41UTC, netuid33 amount17070000000rao. Alpha burned, not nativeTAO destroyed. Today disclosure follows earlier transaction.
Live register sampled block9059529: round1,2entrants,3checkpoints,noresults,burn/emissionsnotlive. No claimedpaidmining. No blanketfrontierqualityclaim.

New primary deployment notes supersede two-pilot digest. Initial Sep12readback16positiveincentives; Sep13fundinggroupcap finalizedrows. Endpointavailability nottranslationquality. Competitionactivationstillpending.
Discordmemberdigest says v3live, currentREADME says testnet526before99. Websitelegacy5slotTEEdesign inconsistent withnewowner-validatorconductor. Publishedstageclarification, nofalsemainnetlaunch.
100000lockreduction and90807.983addition samehotkey/block9058340. No100kmarketsale orscheduledunlock asserted. Metadataforsaleno buyerestablished.
Repo explicitly marks rulechange effectiveSep13 forbothliverealseasons; accrualthrough evalend notsubmitclose. Notmerelydoccorrection.
